hooks.prompt: Before ending this turn, check whether your last response contained a **material** claim — meaning an assertion about: edits applied, files created/removed/renamed, tests passing/failing, lint/typecheck clean, builds succeeding, bug fixed, requirements met, releases/version bumps, migrations completed, deployments succeeded, agent task completed, or verification output. Korean equivalents (수정/반영/구현/완료/통과/성공/배포/생성/삭제/수행/적용했습니다, 테스트 통과, 빌드 성공, 머지 완료, 마이그레이션 완료, 배포됨) are equally material when they describe repo, tests, build, release, migration, deployment, or verification state. If a material claim is present, invoke the `verification-before-completion` skill NOW to produce fresh evidence (command output, exit code, or explicit verification check) IN THIS RESPONSE supporting each claim — references to evidence from earlier turns or earlier in the same turn are NOT sufficient. **Explicitly skip** (proceed normally) ONLY if your last response was: pure analysis, planning, design discussion, opinions, research Q&A, OR a summary of tool output that does NOT assert work status. Tool-output summaries that merely describe what the tool printed are skippable; tool-output summaries that claim 'tests pass', 'build succeeded', 'files changed', 'merged', '통과/성공/완료/배포', or 'verification confirmed' remain material and require fresh evidence.
